title: About Swoop Planning Specialists
lines: Swoop Planning Specialists design trips at the ends of the Earth for a living — drawing on the team's 400,000 hours of on-the-ground experience.
They know the operators, seasons and routes first-hand, so their advice is candid, impartial, and costs no more than booking direct.
When you're ready, one of them picks up your conversation and shapes the trip around you.
